_comment: PCI DSS 4.0 Req 11.6.1 — Approved security header baseline for payment-adjacent webchat routes.

x-content-type-options.pciRequirement: Prevents MIME-type sniffing attacks on payment page scripts

x-frame-options.pciRequirement: Prevents clickjacking on payment pages (fallback for legacy browsers)

referrer-policy.pciRequirement: Prevents referrer leakage of payment page URLs

permissions-policy.pciRequirement: Restricts sensitive API access on payment pages

content-security-policy.pciRequirement: CSP must restrict script execution; unsafe-eval is forbidden on payment pages

strict-transport-security.pciRequirement: HSTS required in production to enforce TLS for payment pages
